description: Unitless stock beta for a European asset relative to the regional liquidity-weighted market_return, typically estimated over a long rolling window (e.g., ~504 trading days)
Idiosyncratic 1-day return for a European asset unexplained by the market factor, computed as actual return minus beta times market_return, expressed in decimal
Simple moving average dollar average daily trading volume for European instruments, used as a liquidity weight (dollar units)
Exponentially decayed dollar average daily trading volume for European instruments, used as a liquidity weight (dollar units)
Short-term volatility estimate for European instruments, expressed in decimal terms
